items.evidence: FSP read-only inventory records exact D/H/J1/J2/Psi for all three controls; RCWA rasterization provenance is not persisted in the prior stage
FDTD x/y span and RCWA cell are both 432 nm
FSP audit confirms pillar_1 rotation 0 and pillar_2 rotation Psi with Psi-dependent center offsets; prior RCWA artifact does not preserve the geometry-to-grid transform
FDTD background index 1 with no explicit substrate/superstrate object; RCWA used air on both exterior sides
FDTD H_global = 550 nm for all controls; RCWA contract records 550 nm patterned layer
FDTD T and field monitors are at z approximately 1000 nm; prior RCWA spectra contain no output-plane or propagation-phase metadata
FDTD FSP and RCWA both identify APCD_TIO2_NATIVE_M1; numerical interpolation crosswalk against the FSP material object was not recorded
FDTD source is Forward at z=-250 nm; RCWA normal incidence is documented, but the p/s-to-x/y sign crosswalk is not independently sealed
Complex J crosswalk and coordinate handedness are not recoverable from the prior RCWA artifact alone; energy closure does not establish basis identity
FDTD periodic x/y and PML z; RCWA periodic lateral cell and open exterior layers
RCWA and FDTD compare wavelength in nm; formal diagnostic points are 435-465 nm
No explicit propagation-phase removal or common reference plane is recorded
FDTD extraction is from the z=1000 nm field/T plane; RCWA plane is not recorded in the prior production provenance
Target order is (0,0); existing order-resolved artifact reports zero other propagating orders across 435-465 nm
RCWA order power closure is excellent, but closure alone does not prove complex amplitude normalization matches FDTD
No common reference-plane correction is present in the prior RCWA spectra
No sealed FDTD-to-RCWA handedness/basis transform is stored

conclusion: Energy closure is not sufficient evidence of a common complex-Jones physics contract; reference plane, basis/handedness, and RCWA geometry rasterization provenance remain unresolved.
